title: Open pro-etale module pullback preserves K-injective complexes
statement: Let $j:S\to Z$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme; def-weil-open-immersion]. On their pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $R$ and $R'$ be sheaves of commutative rings, with a specified isomorphism $c:j^{-1}R\simeq R'$. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the native pullback $j_c^*$, namely inverse image followed by change of rings along $c$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image; def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Then $j_c^*$ preserves K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]: for every unbounded K-injective complex $I$ of $R$-module sheaves on $Z$, the termwise image $j_c^* I$ is K-injective on $S$. This includes empty opens and arbitrary coefficient rings.

source.place: Tag 08FI, lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open; proetale.tex Tag 09A5, section-morphism; sites.tex Tag 00XZ, section-localize.

proof.text: Identify the open inverse-image module functor with overFunctor followed by the inverse open-site equivalence. The ringed open comparison supplies this natural isomorphism. The exactness of overFunctor supplies its additive structure.

Restriction to the localized site preserves K-injectives: extension by zero is an exact left adjoint. The inverse site equivalence is additive and preserves K-injectives. Composition and transport along the comparison therefore give preservation for native module inverse image.

Along the isomorphism c, scalar extension is naturally isomorphic to restriction along c inverse. The latter is the inverse scalar equivalence. Its additive inverse functor preserves K-injectives. Compose with native inverse image and transport preservation along this scalar-extension comparison. No witness is chosen from an unproved mere-existence theorem: the equivalences are the established canonical constructions and the comparison theorem determines the required natural isomorphism.

theorem open_pullback_preservesKInjectiveComplexes {S Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : S ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology S) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage j CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ R') :
    (proEtaleRingModulePullback j R R' c).PreservesKInjectiveComplexes
